subject: Mac version 3.4.2 consistently crashes when doing any plots

messages.author: 13ed8bb81584a06b
messages.subject: Mac version 3.4.2 consistently crashes when doing any plots
parts:
Every plot I have tried so far has led to segfault  in R. I'm on Mac OS 10.10.2 , R version 3.1.3.

Rattle is completely unresponsive while waiting for me to quit R, although X11 seems ok. 
I had lots of upgrade  problems, it's quite possible that GTk2 was not installed properly. 

I will update this if we find a workaround. Probably we will try regressing to an earlier version of Rattle.

Here's the message in R:
*** caught segfault ***
address 0x4, cause 'memory not mapped'

Traceback:
 1: .Call("do_asCairoDevice", widget, as.numeric(pointsize), w, h,     PACKAGE = "cairoDevice")
 2: cairoDevice::asCairoDevice(da)
 3: newPlot()
 4: executeHistPlot2(new.dataset, hisplots, target, targets, stratify,     sampling, pmax)
 5: executeExplorePlot(avdataset)
 6: executeExploreTab()
 7: dispatchExecuteButton()
 8: doTryCatch(return(expr), name, parentenv, handler)
 9: tryCatchOne(expr, names, parentenv, handlers[[1L]])
10: tryCatchList(expr, classes, parentenv, handlers)
11: tryCatch(dispatchExecuteButton(), interrupt = function(m) setStatusBar(Rtxt("Processing interrupted by user.")),     finally = set.cursor())
12: (function (action, window) {    if (!is.null(crv$executing) && crv$executing)         return()    crv$executing <- TRUE    on.exit(crv$executing <- FALSE)    setStatusBar()    theWidget("rattle_window")$setFocus()    set.cursor("watch")    tryCatch(dispatchExecuteButton(), interrupt = function(m) setStatusBar(Rtxt("Processing interrupted by user.")),         finally = set.cursor())    return()})(<pointer: 0x7fb538ddcc00>)

Possible actions:
1: abort (with core dump, if enabled)
2: normal R exit
3: exit R without saving workspace
4: exit R saving workspace
